page.layout: One page of text, one block, set in black letter, in the upper middle of the page. No margin notes, running head or page number.

main_text.p: Wo jemands an diesen Concordiac-ten zweiffeln wolte/ vnd es zubeförde-rung der Warheit von nötten sein solte/ erbeute man sich dieselben alle glaub-wirdig zubeschönen.

page.notes: The faint mirrored lines at the top and in the lower half are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are left out. The hyphenated word at the first line end ("Concordi ac-ten") is read as Concordiac-ten; the word division is uncertain. The black letter is clear, but a few letters in "zubeschönen" and "nötten" are read with some doubt.
